Hi @anany@nvidia.com, forgive me to modify some of the code to pass CI build, since this patch seems inactive for a long time but I need to base on this patch to implement other portion of DSP0267 v1.3.0 support. All features of this patch are not effected, you can takeover back this patch anytime.
Better to do a consexpr define for 4 stating what it means and use that here.

The patch needs to be rebased. From there it should implement support for the newer versions of the packaging format in their entirety, and expose the necessary pin macros.

Can we please try to avoid exposing the checksum value?

We should be able to test this in the library implementation and return an error on failure.

Thanks, Andrew. The goal is to allow updaters to opt out of payload checksum validation, especially in full bundle updates where multiple validations are redundant. This just adds flexibility for specific use cases. Open to suggestions if there's a cleaner approach.
Can you please review this? https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/libpldm/+/81363
Testing the checksum internal to the implementation should remove the need for this.
